**Volume Profile**。Aggregate volume by price ranges; unavailable because its output is not a per-bar series on the same index.

Category: Volume; status: Not a bar-by-bar series。

Not callable yet: Volume Profile bins output by price, with width rows; it is not a market-data time series.
